parents.subject: Materials Science and Engineering
parents.course: Laboratory Studies in Materials Science and Engineering

ns2:section.sectionText: Subjects covered in lab: semiconductors as the catalysts for photoelectrochemical reactions; optical properties of photocatalytic materials, photoelectrochemical properties of photocatalytic materials, and photocatalytic degradation of organics in water. Desired background: electronic materials, electrical ceramics, physical chemistry. Course will meet in 127 KH.
